control_cases: frontier_knee_2060, coordinated, each supply policy, with second event absent
scope: Continuous state down-drill from an annual end-state, not an actual 90-day historical chronology or an annual stock replacement. All policies share the same perfect next-24-hour physical inputs, retain fuel/SOC/thermal/debt and do not reset at event boundaries. First 120 hours are warmup and reported separately. Contracts add bounded paid fuel; their benefits are resource additions, not algorithm gains. Finite designed cohort, not probabilistic reliability or target feasibility proof.
contract_capacity_basis: Independent gross-import channel capacity from annual state; actual normal arrivals remain separate.
zero_coal_control: Knee 2060, coordinated, both supply policies; set coal normal-import arrival and channel capacity to zero, holding all other initial states and inputs fixed.
